routes.title: Spedizione dei Mille, 1860
routes.summary: From Quarto dei Mille to Teano. The stops follow the dates. Naples is 7 September. Teano is 26 October.

routes.title: L'esilio di Dante
routes.summary: From the sentence in Firenze to the last years in Ravenna. These years are before 1796. The map shows 1796 jurisdiction.

stops.label: Last years in Ravenna. Dante dies here in 1321

routes.title: Dalla Sicilia a New York
routes.summary: A sample southern journey from Castrogiovanni through Palermo and Napoli to Ellis Island.

stops.label: Rail to the port of Palermo, 1904

routes.title: Dal Veneto a Buenos Aires
routes.summary: A sample northern journey from Austrian Udine to the Hotel de Inmigrantes. The 1866 stop is 1 July, before the October plebiscite.

stops.label: 1 July 1866 is still Lombardo-Veneto. The plebiscite is 21 October 1866
Rail to the port of Genova, 1888

routes.title: Rotta di emigrazione, Lercara Friddi
routes.summary: A sample chain from a Sicilian town through Palermo to New York.

ports.name: Porto di Genova
ports.catchment: Piedmont, Lombardy, Veneto, Emilia, and Tuscany.
ports.routes: Early routes to Buenos Aires, Montevideo, and New York.
ports.archives: CISEI — Centro Internazionale Studi Emigrazione Italiana, Genova. Arrival lists also sit at Ellis Island and Castle Garden.

ports.name: Porto di Napoli
ports.catchment: Campania, Calabria, Basilicata, Abruzzo, Molise, and Puglia.
ports.routes: The main departure port for New York and Ellis Island.
ports.archives: Passenger manifests at Ellis Island and Castle Garden. The port lists also sit with the Naples harbor records and CISEI.

ports.name: Porto di Palermo
ports.routes: Routes to New York and New Orleans.
ports.archives: Ellis Island and Castle Garden arrival lists. CISEI holds the wider emigration studies.

ports.name: Porto di Messina
ports.routes: Steamship calls toward Naples, New York, and New Orleans.
ports.archives: Ellis Island arrival lists and CISEI.

ports.name: Porto di Trieste
ports.catchment: Friuli, Trentino, the Julian March, and Dalmatia.
ports.routes: Austro-Hungarian Lloyd sailings from the Habsburg port.
ports.archives: Lloyd and port lists, plus Ellis Island for transatlantic arrivals. CISEI covers the Italian side of the study.

ports.name: Porto di Livorno
ports.routes: A smaller embarkation port beside Genova for American and South American sailings.
ports.archives: Ellis Island arrival lists and CISEI.

ports.name: Modane alpine rail crossing
ports.routes: Overland seasonal migration and the rail path toward Le Havre and Cherbourg.
ports.archives: French port lists at Le Havre and Cherbourg, then Ellis Island for the ocean crossing. CISEI for the Italian departure study.

ports.name: Chiasso alpine rail crossing
ports.catchment: Lombardy, Veneto, and the Swiss border.
ports.routes: Overland migration through Switzerland toward the French Atlantic ports.
ports.archives: French port lists at Le Havre and Cherbourg, then Ellis Island. CISEI for the Italian departure study.
